sloka: एवमुक्त्वा च काकुत्स्थं प्रशस्य च पुनः पुनः ।पुनरेवापरं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनः ।। ७.६४.१ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā ca kākutsthaṁ praśasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।punarevāparaṁ vākyamuvāca raghunandanaḥ ।। 7.64.1 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus to Rama and praised him repeatedly, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, then spoke another statement.
